mascot: Civic Captain Chaya — a friendly community guide with a whistle, a walkie-talkie and a big helping heart

slides.title: Our Neighbourhood Helpers 🧑‍🚒
slides.text: Many people work to make our lives better! Teachers teach us, doctors treat us, police keep us safe, postmen bring letters, farmers grow food and safai karamcharis keep streets clean. We depend on them all!
slides.spoken: Neighbourhood helpers do work that serves everyone.

slides.title: The Postman Connects Us 📮
slides.text: The postman carries letters and parcels from far away to our door. Grandparents' letters, exam hall tickets, parcels — the postman walks rain or shine to connect us all!
slides.spoken: The postman brings letters and parcels to our homes.

slides.title: Emergency Helpers and Numbers 🚨
slides.text: In trouble? Call for help! POLICE for safety: 100. FIRE brigade: 101. AMBULANCE for a sick person: 108. These helpers rush to save us any time of day!
slides.spoken: Police 100, fire 101, ambulance 108 — helpers who rush to save us.

slides.title: The Municipality: Our City's Caretaker 🏛️
slides.text: The municipality (nagar palika) looks after the whole town! It collects garbage, supplies drinking water, lights the streets, keeps parks green and clears drains. A clean city is everyone's work plus theirs!
slides.spoken: The municipality keeps our city clean, lit and watered.

slides.title: Everyone's Work Matters 🙏
slides.text: Chapati reaches your plate through MANY hands: the farmer grows wheat, the miller grinds flour, the baker cooks. No work is big or small — every job helps everyone. We must respect all workers!
slides.spoken: Many workers join hands for everything we use — respect them all.

challenges.question: Who brings letters and parcels to our home?
challenges.hint: They walk street to street carrying our mail!
challenges.misconception: The postman delivers letters and parcels to our door.

challenges.question: A fire breaks out in the neighbourhood. Which number do you call?
challenges.misconception: 101 is the fire brigade emergency number in India.

challenges.question: Who treats us when we are sick?
challenges.hint: They check our fever and give us medicine!
challenges.misconception: Doctors treat us when we are ill.

challenges.question: Who keeps our streets clean by collecting garbage?
challenges.misconception: Safai karamcharis of the municipality collect garbage and keep streets clean.

challenges.question: Who grows food for us?
challenges.hint: They work in fields from dawn to dusk!
challenges.misconception: Farmers grow the rice, wheat and vegetables we eat.

challenges.question: Sort each helper: do they keep us SAFE AND HEALTHY, or provide GOODS AND FOOD?
challenges.hint: Safety helpers protect and heal. Goods helpers make or bring things we use.
challenges.misconception: Police and doctors keep us safe and healthy. Farmers and fish sellers provide food.

challenges.question: What is the police emergency number?
challenges.hint: The number for police help in danger!
challenges.misconception: 100 is the police emergency number in India.

challenges.question: A chapati reaches your plate through ______.
challenges.hint: Think of everyone who touched that wheat along the way!
challenges.misconception: Farmer, miller and baker all work together — many hands make one chapati.
